brief.text: Closed-end funds represent a strong concentration among cluster transactions, with BPRE, CRAFX, FTHY, and SWZ all drawing multiple buyers. BBD stands out dramatically for participant volume, where an exceptional 22 insiders reported combined purchases totaling $27,962,071, representing the largest dollar commitment in the cluster category. For notable individual actions, GME CEO Ryan Cohen filed the largest single purchase at $17,084,270, while PAM generated heavy interest across both tables, combining $16,370,248 in total cluster activity alongside a $5,564,817 outlay from Vice President Damian Miguel Mindlin.
